name: Taker rebates, fee tiers and promo extraction (cost overlay for every taker strategy)
one_line: Consolidate taker flow into one account to climb the 3-50% rebate tiers, route every taker agent by the live per-market feeSchedule (fee-free geopolitics, game-day NFL, legacy 0.03 sports futures), and harvest bounded Polymarket US credits; it re-prices other strategies and earns nothing alone.
maturity: Established programme, not a strategy: $1.22M of taker rebates paid on-chain in the week of 21-27 Sep 2026 to 7,000 wallets; top earners are crypto and sports takers, five of the top twelve net losers after fees; wash-climbing negative-sum
requires_ai: no; arithmetic on public feeSchedule, wV and Data API fee fields
edge: Venue subsidy with per-account tiers plus fee configuration that changes without notice
capital: none for the overlay; Gold needs ~$6-10k of fees per 30 days (~$170-400k taker notional)
build_time: 1-2 weeks solo on an existing execution stack; US leg adds KYC and a separate client
opportunity_size: $1.22M/week venue-wide ($174k/day, down 32% from ~$255k/day; mix or policy unverified); 3-18% of own fees for a $1k-$10k book
expected_results: Top wallet: $545k rebates vs $212-250k realised PnL; solo $30-$1,900/month at Bronze-Gold (derived); routing saves up to 2.5% of notional
competition: Per-account, uncontested; underlying flow is the crowded taker niches
flag: none for consolidating own flow; grey multi-wallet; prohibited wash/self-match, self-referral, extra KYC identities
validate: Replay 90 days of fills through live feeSchedule and wV ledger; reconcile pUSD from distributor 0x520B… to tier x fees within 1%
top_risk: Parameters discretionary and already cut; rebate cannot rescue losing takers
solo_fit_reason: As an overlay it is cheap, deterministic and benefits every taker bot the team already runs (routing alone is worth more than the tier for a $1k-$10k book); as a standalone income it is nothing, Gold-plus tiers need six-figure fee-paying notional per month, and the US promo pieces are bounded to a few hundred dollars per KYC identity.
speed_class: speed-insensitive for tiers (daily); execution-sensitive for fee-flag routing
results_1k: workable as overlay; $0-$70/month rebate at Bronze-Silver (derived)
min_capital: none; first $2k wV (~$60-100 of fees) already pays 3%
capacity_ceiling: 50% of own fees; programme budget ~$1.2M/week; promo credits capped per identity
services: Polymarket docs changelog and programme pages
Polymarket Data API v2 user-stats / user-pnl
Polygon RPC with log history (Tenderly gateway / Alchemy)
Kalshi or international book as hedge leg (optional)
changes_made: Written 2026-09-28 with live checks: docs pages for taker rebates, fees, maker rebates, referral, changelog and market-details; Polymarket US fees, volume, user-programs, overview, market-maker, referral and changelog pages; Gamma fee-schedule census of the 2,100 most-traded active markets; CLOB market endpoint on six markets; seven-day on-chain census of pUSD transfers from the taker-rebate distributor via Tenderly; Data API v2 user-stats for the twelve largest weekly recipients; DefiLlama daily gross fees.
Maturity set to 'Established programme, not a strategy' per the critic; category labelled as overlay.

Corrected the brief: Polymarket US refer-a-friend credit is $25 (not $50) per referral; US fee page now dated effective 2026-09-25 (E1 had 2026-09-17); the taker-rebate launch has no changelog entry; legacy sports_fees_v2 (0.03 / 25%) futures are live and untouched by the July change; NFL zero_fees flips at least four hours before kickoff, not at kickoff.

Added the Polymarket US cross-reference index (files 01, 06, 08, 28, 32) with the single gating decision, and an explicit statement that sportsbook bonus conversion with Polymarket US / Kalshi as the lay leg is unverified and bounded.
Wash-climbing arithmetic derived from live programme terms (ceiling 80% of fees at Obsidian as sole maker; 18-57% on the way up; Obsidian entry costs ~$304k of crypto fees in 30 days).

Cite-check + skeptic pass 2026-09-28 (21 numbered sources re-fetched or re-queried, 3 pack claims checked; 0 removed, 0 unreachable): all seven on-chain rebate windows re-run via Tenderly and reproduced to the cent ($1,220,944 / 7,000 wallets / 6.1% / 32.1% / median $10 / 135 at $1k+); Gamma census recounted to 2,047 unique markets (53 pagination duplicates) and every count and share corrected (sports_fees_v2 143, geopolitics 174 at 9.8%, zero_fees 9.7%); 'week-4 NFL lines' corrected to the 2-6 October games (the 27 September games had closed) and the router claim reworded; Eagles-Bears re-checked at 20:58 UTC (still zero_fees, CLOB base-fee fields 1000 even on this zero-fee market); Gamma offset limit corrected to 'above 2,000 rejected, use /markets/keyset'; twelve recipients' user-stats re-fetched: realised PnL of the top wallet is +$250k on user-stats vs +$212k on the user-pnl series (rebate multiple restated as 2.2-2.6x), the $9.99M loser is now -$10.0M, the second wallet +$0.78M, and the 8-33% rebate/fee range now excludes the anomalous 55% wallet explicitly; Obsidian notional corrected to ~$8-20M; wV formula now carries the docs' bonus multiplier; Covers page fetched (updated 2026-09-28; its $350 referral cap contradicts the docs' 50 referrals) and Dark Horse Odds fetched (dated 2026-09-22; Kalshi settles inactive-player props at the last pre-game price, not 'No'); US changelog range corrected to 2026-09-21; E2's $2.04M restated as eight runs; the 'growing' trend claim replaced by a 32%-per-day drop flagged as mix-or-policy unverified; per-$1,000-notional rebate values added to the size table assumptions; 'nobody publishes' softened to 'not found'.
open_doubts: The Data API `fees_refunded` field is undocumented and one wallet's taker_rebate / fees ratio is 54.9%, above the 50% maximum, so wallet-level rebate ratios are indicative only; `/v2/user-stats` and the last point of `/v2/user-pnl` also disagree on the top wallet's realised PnL by ~$38k.
The game-day zero_fees timing rests on one observed NFL game (flag on at least 4 h 9 min before kickoff and still on at 20:58 UTC); when the flag is set and cleared in general is unverified.

The 22-28 Sep runs' $1.22M versus E2's $2.04M over eight runs (13-20 Sep) is a 32% drop per day; whether it is volume mix (NFL zero-fee days, a slower crypto week) or a programme change is unverified.
Whether the Polymarket US Volume Incentive Program currently has any live pool was not checked against the US incentives API; the docs list only the May NBA pool.

Promo-conversion retention (~90-94%) and sportsbook bonus conversion with Polymarket US / Kalshi as the lay leg rest on arithmetic plus one affiliate page and one guide; no practitioner PnL was found.
DefiLlama's daily gross-fee series is third-party accounting; the 5.6% rebate-to-fee ratio depends on its definition of fees.
The 'legacy sports_fees_v2 futures are still tradable at 0.03' finding is a census fact; whether Polymarket intends to migrate them was not asked or verified.
